<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<messageSchema package="openmdta.keyfigures" id="10" version="2" byteOrder="littleEndian">
  <types>
    <composite name="messageHeader">
      <type name="blockLength" primitiveType="uint16"/>
      <type name="templateId" primitiveType="uint16"/>
      <type name="schemaId" primitiveType="uint16"/>
      <type name="version" primitiveType="uint16"/>
    </composite>
    <composite name="varDataEncoding">
      <type name="length" primitiveType="uint32"/>
      <type name="varData" primitiveType="uint8" length="0"/>
    </composite>
    <composite name="largeGroupSizeEncoding">
      <type name="blockLength" primitiveType="uint16"/>
      <type name="numInGroup" primitiveType="uint32"/>
    </composite>
  </types>
  <!-- Only authenticated gateway sessions may supply grants. Action: 1 schema,
       2 instrument, 3 search, 4 describe, 5 status, 6 snapshot, 7 feed.
       Age mode: 0 absent, 1 elapsed, 2 trading time, 3 last completed session.
       Presence bit 0 marks priceCutoffMs. Quality: 0 any, 1 RT, 2 DL, 3 EOD. -->
  <message name="KeyfiguresRequest" id="1" blockLength="20">
    <field name="action" id="1" type="uint8" offset="0"/>
    <field name="ageMode" id="2" type="uint8" offset="1"/>
    <field name="presence" id="3" type="uint8" offset="2"/>
    <field name="reserved" id="4" type="uint8" offset="3"/>
    <field name="after" id="5" type="uint64" offset="4"/>
    <field name="priceCutoffMs" id="6" type="uint64" offset="12"/>
    <group name="grants" id="7" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="1">
      <field name="quality" id="8" type="uint8" offset="0"/>
      <data name="package" id="9" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <data name="key" id="10" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <data name="contractFingerprint" id="11" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <!-- Complete KeyfiguresSearchQuery frame, empty for other actions. -->
    <data name="searchQuerySbe" id="12" type="varDataEncoding"/>
  </message>
  <!-- Public results bind every customer field ID and scalar type to contractFingerprint.
       A row carries exactly the contract's declared fields, in column-ID order; its
       projected blocks are rebuilt from the same checked fields and the pinned contract.
       Schema and instrument results are one frame. A search result is zero or more
       KeyfiguresRowChunk frames followed by its KeyfiguresSearchResult summary. -->
  <message name="KeyfiguresSchemaResult" id="2" blockLength="36">
    <field name="clock" id="1" type="uint8" offset="0"/>
    <field name="allowNoPriceCutoff" id="2" type="uint8" offset="1"/>
    <field name="maxFacetValues" id="3" type="uint16" offset="2"/>
    <field name="priceCutoffMs" id="4" type="uint64" offset="4"/>
    <field name="maxRequestPriceCutoffMs" id="5" type="uint64" offset="12"/>
    <field name="maxPage" id="6" type="uint32" offset="20"/>
    <field name="maxCandidates" id="7" type="uint32" offset="24"/>
    <field name="maxOffset" id="8" type="uint32" offset="28"/>
    <field name="reserved" id="9" type="uint32" offset="32"/>
    <group name="fields" id="10" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="3">
      <field name="columnId" id="11" type="uint16" offset="0"/>
      <field name="facet" id="12" type="uint8" offset="2"/>
      <group name="operators" id="13" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
        <data name="name" id="14" type="varDataEncoding"/>
      </group>
    </group>
    <group name="facets" id="15" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
      <group name="precedence" id="16" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
        <data name="value" id="17" type="varDataEncoding"/>
      </group>
      <data name="name" id="18" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <data name="catalog" id="19" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <data name="contractFingerprint" id="20" type="varDataEncoding"/>
  </message>
  <message name="KeyfiguresInstrumentResult" id="4" blockLength="18">
    <field name="clock" id="1" type="uint8" offset="0"/>
    <field name="priceAgeMode" id="2" type="uint8" offset="1"/>
    <field name="epoch" id="3" type="uint64" offset="2"/>
    <field name="priceCutoffMs" id="4" type="uint64" offset="10"/>
    <data name="catalog" id="5" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <data name="contractFingerprint" id="6" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <data name="rowSbe" id="7" type="varDataEncoding"/>
  </message>
  <!-- Search rows precede this summary in KeyfiguresRowChunk frames; rowCount is their total. -->
  <message name="KeyfiguresSearchResult" id="5" blockLength="56">
    <field name="clock" id="1" type="uint8" offset="0"/>
    <field name="priceAgeMode" id="2" type="uint8" offset="1"/>
    <!-- bit 0 snapshotCutoffUs; bit 1 liveCutoffUs; bit 2 nextCursor. -->
    <field name="presence" id="3" type="uint8" offset="2"/>
    <field name="flags" id="4" type="uint8" offset="3"/>
    <field name="epoch" id="5" type="uint64" offset="4"/>
    <field name="priceCutoffMs" id="6" type="uint64" offset="12"/>
    <field name="snapshotCutoffUs" id="7" type="uint64" offset="20"/>
    <field name="liveCutoffUs" id="8" type="uint64" offset="28"/>
    <field name="snapshotMatches" id="9" type="uint64" offset="36"/>
    <field name="candidates" id="10" type="uint64" offset="44"/>
    <field name="rowCount" id="11" type="uint32" offset="52"/>
    <group name="facets" id="14" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
      <group name="values" id="15" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="8">
        <field name="total" id="16" type="uint64" offset="0"/>
        <data name="value" id="17" type="varDataEncoding"/>
      </group>
      <data name="name" id="18" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <group name="facetMeta" id="19" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="1">
      <field name="exhaustive" id="20" type="uint8" offset="0"/>
      <data name="name" id="21" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <data name="catalog" id="22" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <data name="contractFingerprint" id="23" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <data name="nextCursor" id="24" type="varDataEncoding"/>
  </message>
  <!-- Bounded search-row delivery. Each public owner frame is at most 1 MiB; chunks
       arrive in order before the KeyfiguresSearchResult summary. firstRow is the
       zero-based index of this chunk's first row in the complete result. -->
  <message name="KeyfiguresRowChunk" id="10" blockLength="4">
    <field name="firstRow" id="1" type="uint32" offset="0"/>
    <group name="rows" id="2" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
      <data name="rowSbe" id="3" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
  </message>
  <message name="KeyfiguresRow" id="6" blockLength="17">
    <field name="eventUs" id="1" type="uint64" offset="0"/>
    <field name="messageId" id="2" type="uint64" offset="8"/>
    <!-- bit 0 eventUs; bit 1 messageId; bit 2 reason. -->
    <field name="presence" id="3" type="uint8" offset="16"/>
    <group name="fields" id="4" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="21">
      <field name="columnId" id="5" type="uint16" offset="0"/>
      <!-- kind: 1 string, 2 integer, 3 number, 4 boolean, 5 string list (a
           contract field with multiple: true); present 0 null, 1 value.
           Only kind 5 uses listValues and only kind 1 uses textValue. -->
      <field name="kind" id="6" type="uint8" offset="2"/>
      <field name="present" id="7" type="uint8" offset="3"/>
      <field name="numberValue" id="8" type="double" offset="4"/>
      <field name="integerValue" id="9" type="int64" offset="12"/>
      <field name="booleanValue" id="10" type="uint8" offset="20"/>
      <group name="listValues" id="18" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
        <data name="value" id="19" type="varDataEncoding"/>
      </group>
      <data name="textValue" id="11" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <group name="sources" id="12" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="1">
      <!-- role 1 primary, 2 dependency. -->
      <field name="role" id="13" type="uint8" offset="0"/>
      <data name="provenanceSbe" id="14" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <data name="requirementsSbe" id="15" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <data name="reason" id="16" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <data name="contractFingerprint" id="17" type="varDataEncoding"/>
  </message>
  <message name="KeyfiguresProvenance" id="7" blockLength="35">
    <field name="cutoffUs" id="1" type="uint64" offset="0"/>
    <field name="priceCutoffMs" id="2" type="uint64" offset="8"/>
    <field name="quoteEventUs" id="3" type="uint64" offset="16"/>
    <field name="messageId" id="4" type="uint64" offset="24"/>
    <field name="quality" id="5" type="uint8" offset="32"/>
    <field name="clock" id="6" type="uint8" offset="33"/>
    <field name="priceAgeMode" id="7" type="uint8" offset="34"/>
    <group name="fallback" id="8" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
      <data name="input" id="9" type="varDataEncoding"/>
      <data name="reason" id="10" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <data name="input" id="11" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <data name="catalog" id="12" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <data name="key" id="13" type="varDataEncoding"/>
  </message>
  <message name="KeyfiguresRequirements" id="8" blockLength="0">
    <group name="clauses" id="1" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="1">
      <!-- kind 0 Public, 1 AnyOf. -->
      <field name="kind" id="2" type="uint8" offset="0"/>
      <group name="alternatives" id="3" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
        <data name="namespace" id="4" type="varDataEncoding"/>
        <data name="license" id="5" type="varDataEncoding"/>
      </group>
    </group>
  </message>
  <!-- Authenticated owner-private diagnostics and retained-epoch inspection; never exposed as public result 103. -->
  <message name="KeyfiguresDebugResult" id="9" blockLength="0">
    <data name="debugJson" id="1" type="varDataEncoding"/>
  </message>
  <message name="KeyfiguresSearchQuery" id="3" blockLength="13">
    <field name="queryOffset" id="1" type="uint32" offset="0"/>
    <field name="queryLimit" id="2" type="uint32" offset="4"/>
    <field name="budget" id="3" type="uint32" offset="8"/>
    <!-- bit 0 keys present; bit 1 cursor present. Empty values remain distinct. -->
    <field name="presence" id="4" type="uint8" offset="12"/>
    <group name="filters" id="5" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
      <group name="values" id="6" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
        <data name="value" id="7" type="varDataEncoding"/>
      </group>
      <data name="name" id="8" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <group name="facets" id="9" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
      <data name="name" id="10" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <group name="keys" id="11" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
      <data name="key" id="12" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <group name="ranges" id="13" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="49">
      <!-- bits 0..3: gt, ge, lt, le present. -->
      <field name="presence" id="14" type="uint8" offset="0"/>
      <field name="gt" id="15" type="double" offset="1"/>
      <field name="ge" id="16" type="double" offset="9"/>
      <field name="lt" id="17" type="double" offset="17"/>
      <field name="le" id="18" type="double" offset="25"/>
      <field name="absoluteMargin" id="19" type="double" offset="33"/>
      <field name="relativeMargin" id="20" type="double" offset="41"/>
      <data name="field" id="21" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <group name="sorts" id="22" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="1">
      <field name="descending" id="23" type="uint8" offset="0"/>
      <data name="field" id="24" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <data name="text" id="25" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <data name="cursor" id="26" type="varDataEncoding"/>
  </message>
</messageSchema>
